page.notes: Left page: line numbers 10–60 are printed at the right of the column and are kept as notes. Right page: the number 50 and 60 at the left edge are read with some doubt; no page number is printed on the right page. The running head is read as "IOA" on both pages. The word "Antigratulatio" is joined from "morte.An" and "tigratulatio" without a printed hyphen, so it is doubtful. Doubtful readings: "Odyffeg", "Grece", "fi", "Hef", "Digestiv[?]eris" (line-end split). The catchword "in qua" stands alone below the last line. Initial I/J and U/V were normalised by the rules (Joannes, Jacobi, utriusq, uitae).
